name: Troubleshoot hardware and device connectivity failures
description: Users asked for help diagnosing and resolving hardware or connection malfunctions in consumer and personal electronic devices. These requests covered a wide range of issues, including devices failing to boot, power on, or detect peripherals, as well as physical damage and connectivity failures with accessories like printers and phones.
